## Scope

The audit covered 211 second reads taken during the quarter. It examined the relationship between the first and second grades for the sets included in the review. The purpose was to assess grading consistency across the audited material. The review was limited to the second reads identified for this audit and does not present findings beyond that scope.

## Result

First and second grades agreed in 68.7 per cent of sets. This result provides the overall agreement measure for the audit. It should be read alongside the per-grader results, which are available in the attached spreadsheet. Those results are discussed with each grader privately to support appropriate review of individual grading patterns and to maintain confidentiality. No further breakdown is included in this summary.
